## Family interaction law
Compress, never float.

Interactive raised surfaces move toward the plane on hover/contact and consume remaining depth on press. Generic upward hover lift is non-conformant.

## Agent guidance
Treat each flavor as a visual/personality layer over a shared family contract. Do not assume flavors are palette swaps. Preserve semantic tokens, tactile state meaning, accessibility behavior, light/dark support, fluid sizing and reduced-motion behavior.
